import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

from control_tower.network_contract import digest

repo = Path.cwd()
doc = (repo / "docs/LOCAL_REVIEW_RECOVERY_RUNBOOK.md").read_text()
section = doc.split("## Prepare and reuse a selective registry inspection\n", 1)[1].split(
    "## Observe the existing mission privately\n", 1)[0]
templates = re.findall(r"```sh\n(.*?)\n```", section, re.S)
assert len(templates) == 2
source = "2583a09358690c5e8a9ee37b878485bbb1567b5b"
hash_bytes = lambda value: hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
observations = []

with TemporaryDirectory(prefix="registry-runbook-") as directory:
    root = Path(directory)
    registry = dict(schema_version=1, kind="jarvis.destination_registry", registry_id="synthetic-registry",
        revision=1, source_revision=source, configuration_version="synthetic.v1", visibility="owner_private",
        entries=[dict(project_id=project, platform=platform, destination_id="synthetic-destination",
            resource_id="synthetic-resource", allowed_actions=["read"])
            for project, platform in (("ai-jarvis", "codex"), ("linux-education", "gemini"))])
    path = root / "registry.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(registry))
    original = path.read_bytes()
    values = dict(TASK_ROOT=str(root), REGISTRY_FILE="registry.json", REGISTRY_SHA256=digest(registry),
        REGISTRY_SOURCE_REVISION=source, REGISTRY_REVISION="1", PROJECT_ID="ai-jarvis", PLATFORM_ID="codex")

    def execute(label, template, changes=None, output=None, omit_platform=False, expected=0):
        selected = {**values, **(changes or {})}
        args = [selected[word[1:]] if word.startswith("$") else word for word in shlex.split(template)]
        args[0] = sys.executable
        if output is not None:
            args[args.index("--out") + 1] = output
        if omit_platform:
            position = args.index("--platform")
            del args[position:position + 2]
        result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
        assert result.returncode == expected, (label, result.stderr)
        if expected:
            assert not result.stdout
        assert path.read_bytes() == original
        assert not list(root.rglob("*.sqlite3"))
        observations.append(dict(case=label, argv=[word.replace(str(root), "FIXTURE_ROOT") for word in args],
            exit_code=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout.replace(str(root), "FIXTURE_ROOT"),
            stderr=result.stderr.replace(str(root), "FIXTURE_ROOT")))
        return root / args[args.index("--out") + 1]

    first = execute("prepare", templates[0])
    prepared = first.read_bytes()
    record = json.loads(prepared)
    assert record["entry_count"] == 1 and record["platform_counts"] == {"codex": 1}
    assert record["visibility"] == "owner_private" and record["acceptance_state"] == "proposed_unverified"
    assert not record["dispatch_authorized"] and record["external_actions"] == 0
    assert first.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o600
    values["INSPECTION_SHA256"] = record["receipt_sha256"]  # Synthetic fixture pin, not independent review.
    second = execute("reuse", templates[1])
    assert second.read_bytes() == prepared and second.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o600
    byte_hash = hash_bytes(prepared)
    assert byte_hash != values["INSPECTION_SHA256"]
    failures = [
        ("changed-platform", dict(PLATFORM_ID="gemini")),
        ("wrong-registry-digest", dict(REGISTRY_SHA256="0" * 64)),
        ("wrong-source", dict(REGISTRY_SOURCE_REVISION="f" * 40)),
        ("wrong-revision", dict(REGISTRY_REVISION="2")),
        ("file-byte-hash-is-not-receipt-hash", dict(INSPECTION_SHA256=byte_hash)),
        ("missing-input", dict(REGISTRY_FILE="missing.json")),
    ]
    for label, changes in failures:
        rejected = execute(label, templates[1], changes, output="reports/" + label + ".json", expected=1)
        assert not rejected.exists()
    execute("existing-output", templates[1], expected=1)
    rejected = execute("omitted-platform-same-count", templates[1],
        output="reports/omitted-platform.json", omit_platform=True, expected=1)
    assert not rejected.exists()
    assert first.read_bytes() == prepared and second.read_bytes() == prepared
    assert not list(root.rglob(".jarvis-write-*"))
    assert len(list((root / "reports").iterdir())) == 2

syntax = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "*.py"], text=True).splitlines()
for name in syntax:
    ast.parse((repo / name).read_text(), filename=name)
print(json.dumps(dict(templates_checked=2, cli_processes=len(observations), successes=2,
    expected_refusals=8, syntax_files=len(syntax), file_mode="0600", files_byte_identical=True,
    source_bytes_unchanged=True, ledger_created=False, temporary_files_remaining=False,
    fixture_pin_authentication="not_established", observations=observations), indent=2))
